offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures vehicle access control products, including locks, keys, electronic key fobs, latches and power door systems, sold to automotive manufacturers for installation in new vehicles. Production is in its own plants in the United States and Mexico.

primary_products.value: mechanical locks and keys; electronic key fobs; door latches; power sliding door systems; seat and handle access components

customer_segment.value: B2B: automotive original equipment manufacturers, such as domestic and foreign light vehicle makers

revenue_model.value: product sales: components and access systems sold to vehicle makers for new vehicle programs

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: supplies access and security parts bought by vehicle assemblers, taking in raw metal and plastic parts; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures locks, keys and latches in its own plants, sold to automakers

geography_served.value: North America: US and Mexico plants serving vehicle assembly sites in North America, with some customers elsewhere

specialization.value: niche specialist: vehicle access control products covering locks, keys, latches and power door systems

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales made directly to automotive original equipment manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety standards for latches and locks, such as US federal motor vehicle safety rules

notes: Customer mix and geographic reach are based on general knowledge and may have changed.
